Check out the Alopex DLC Launch Trailer for Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate, an action roguelike game developed by Super Evil Megacorp. Players can now access a suite of new additions with the Alopex DLC, packed with the new playable mutant arctic fox character named Alopex. 

The new DLC is also fitted with five new Artifacts, Pepper Challenges, balancing and quality of life improvements, and more. The Alopex DLC for Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate is available now for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store)

description:
Resident Evil Requiem reviewed by Tristan Ogilvie on PlayStation 5. Also available on Xbox Series X|S, PC, and Nintendo Switch 2.

"Like the result of an experiment conducted in an underground Umbrella Corporation lab, Resident Evil Requiem successfully splices two separate strains of survival horror together into the one highly infectious new mutation. It signals the return of a series legend and the arrival of a likeable new lead, amps up the gore to a new stomach-turning standard, and unleashes a scarier breed of zombie alongside some truly beastly boss fights. The lack of any meaningful side content like The Mercenaries mode is a touch disappointing, and I do wonder if a slightly more consistent balance could have been struck with the ebb and flow from jaw-clenching moments of tension to all-out assault, rather than frontloading the story with frights before giving way to a more bullet-riddled back half. title: Resident Evil Requiem Review

author: IGN
description:
Watch the brutal animated trailer for Nightmare Reaper, which reveals that a new update will bring co-op gameplay and improved New Game+ to the retro-inspired first-person shooter game. Nightmare Reaper's free multiplayer update will be available on March 17, 2026.

The multiplayer update will feature a co-op mode where 4 players can play the entire campaign together, including New Game+. The update will also feature a very unique deathmatch mode where players can create custom game modes and fight with randomly generated weapons. Also included in the update are new elite enemies, 15 "shiny" weapon variants with new mechanics, a new minigame, and a new skill tree that will provide high-level content for New Game+ as well as a pile of bug fixes and gameplay improvements.

#NightmareReaper #Gaming #IGN
title: Nightmare Reaper - Official Multiplayer Release Date Trailer

author: IGN
description:
The Kestrel Mk. II takes the spotlight in this latest Elite Dangerous trailer for the space sim game. The Kestrel Mk. II is Elite Dangerous' first ship of 2026, and it is available today in ARX Early Access.

A small frame capable of delivering a big impact, the Kestrel Mk II has been designed to break convention and challenge Elite Dangerous’ heavy-hitting combat ships with a manoeuvrable and aggressive loadout. Complimented by three large hardpoints and a pair of new modules; The Mk II Plasma Shock Accelerator, a fully automatic variant of the existing Shock Cannon, which utilises the ship’s fuel as ammunition, and the Mk II Agile Boost Thrusters, which offer significant lateral and vertical acceleration when boosting, creating an evasive fighter which packs a punch.

#IGN #Gaming
title: Elite Dangerous - Official Kestrel Mk. II Launch Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Check out the first 12 minutes of gameplay from Malpraxis in this latest video for the upcoming game from the developers of Ratshaker. Malpraxis blends medical simulation, psychological horror, and investigative drama. This opening gameplay video showcases the S.P.I.D.E.R. unit startup sequence, shift briefing, a routine calibration exercise that quickly spirals into chaos, and the beginning of a grounded crew medical checkup.

Malpraxis will be available on PC on February 27, 2026. You can wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3350240/MALPRAXIS/

#Malpraxis #Gaming #IGN
title: Malpraxis - First 12 Minutes of Gameplay
